There are always many people at the travel plan. Life is full of small surprises. Sam wants to be a engineer in the future. The bank opens at nine in the morning.
Last Monday, Sam and Nina went to the hotel. Both of them like noodles and tea. Sam learned a lot about music. Our host cooked a wonderful dinner.
Sam is reading a book about music. It takes twenty minutes to get to the hotel by bike. Nina is interested in singing. In fact, the light rail crosses the river twice.
They took many photos at the travel plan. Sam thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Sam is going to travel to Xi'an in December.
